mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_share_link_table ( share_id, share_token, share_owner_id, share_target_type, share_file_id, share_node_id, share_name, share_password, share_has_password, share_expires_at, share_status ) VALUES ( #{share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{share_token}, #{share_owner_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{share_target_type}, #{share_file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{share_node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{share_name}, #{share_password}, #{share_has_password}, #{share_expires_at}, 'active' )
mapper.select: SELECT s.share_id, s.share_token, s.share_owner_id, s.share_target_type, s.share_file_id, s.share_node_id, s.share_name, s.share_password, s.share_has_password, s.share_expires_at, s.share_view_count, s.share_status, s.share_created_at, s.share_updated_at, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.node_name) AS target_name, COALESCE(f.file_size, 0) AS target_size, f.file_type AS file_type, u.user_name AS owner_name FROM pcd_share_link_table s LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON s.share_file_id = f.file_id AND s.share_target_type = 'file' LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON s.share_node_id = d.node_id AND s.share_target_type = 'folder' LEFT JOIN pcd_user_info_table u ON s.share_owner_id = u.user_id WHERE s.share_token = #{share_token}

SELECT s.share_id, s.share_token, s.share_owner_id, s.share_target_type, s.share_file_id, s.share_node_id, s.share_name, s.share_password, s.share_has_password, s.share_expires_at, s.share_view_count, s.share_status, s.share_created_at, s.share_updated_at, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.node_name) AS target_name, COALESCE(f.file_size, 0) AS target_size, f.file_type AS file_type FROM pcd_share_link_table s LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON s.share_file_id = f.file_id AND s.share_target_type = 'file' LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON s.share_node_id = d.node_id AND s.share_target_type = 'folder' WHERE s.share_owner_id = #{owner_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} ORDER BY s.share_created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pcd_share_link_table SET share_status = 'expired' WHERE share_status = 'active' AND share_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND share_expires_at < NOW()
